subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — UI dashboard and CLI command

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this AI-safety taxonomy and dashboard as a core, persistent, plugin-extensible product surface now, or keep it within the existing diagnostics/plugin architecture until ownership and retention are defined?
rationale: The permanent taxonomy, plugin emission authority, sensitive-field policy, retention semantics, and core UI placement are product and security contracts that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor a staged core design
options.body: Approve the direction, consolidate on diagnostics stability, define redaction and SQLite retention first, then land contracts, exporters/plugin policy, and UI separately with direct proof.

options.title: Keep it diagnostics-plugin owned
options.body: Retain only the minimum generic core diagnostic seam and implement specialized storage and presentation through the diagnostics plugins.

options.title: Defer the series
options.body: Pause or close the four-PR series until a sponsored roadmap item defines the taxonomy, data lifecycle, and operator UX.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a staged core design
recommendation.body: Approve the direction, consolidate on diagnostics stability, define redaction and SQLite retention first, then land contracts, exporters/plugin policy, and UI separately with direct proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses core product scope, security boundaries, public plugin contracts, storage policy, gateway authorization, and Control UI placement.
